title: Re-arm Engram delivery after Stop arbitration deadline
outcome: If DeferredByRuntimeStop exceeds its 11 s guard, preparation becomes Rejected while runtime_stop_in_progress is still true; guarded rejection declines cleanup. A later failed Stop can leave an Active live runtime with a current pending marker but no delivered prompt.
acceptance: A Stop that resolves after the arbitration guard cannot strand a current prompt: successful Stop remains superseded; failed Stop resumes delivery or produces an explicit durable failure. Add a deterministic late-resolution regression.
